# wallix-bastion_authdomain_mapping (Resource)

Provides an authentication domain mapping resource, mapping an external directory group to a
Bastion user group for a given authentication domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wallix-bastion_authdomain_mapping" "admins" {
  domain_id      = wallix-bastion_authdomain_ldap.corporate.id
  user_group     = wallix-bastion_usergroup.bastion_admins.group_name
  external_group = "CN=Bastion Admins,OU=Groups,DC=corporate,DC=local"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String)
- `external_group` (String)
- `user_group` (String)

### Read-Only

- `domain` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Usage Notes

`domain_id` accepts the ID of any authentication domain resource (`wallix-bastion_authdomain_ad`,
`wallix-bastion_authdomain_ldap`, `wallix-bastion_authdomain_saml`, or
`wallix-bastion_authdomain_azuread`). `external_group` is the group identifier as returned by
that directory - typically a distinguished name for LDAP/AD, or a group claim value for SAML/Azure
AD.

## Import

Authentication domain mapping can be imported using `<domain_id>/<user_group>`, e.g.

```shell
terraform import wallix-bastion_authdomain_mapping.admins 19fec1050e0dc4b20050568ee445/Bastion_Admins
```
